pull: Clue: Germany claimed her sunk in 1939
body:
Can you name this ship?

On 14 November 1941, this British aircraft carrier rolled over and sank near Gibraltar, the morning after a single torpedo from a German U-boat struck her amidships. Of the 1,488 men aboard, only one was lost.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: HMS Legion alongside the listing Ark Royal to take off survivors, 13 November 1941, the day before she sank. Lt S. J. Beadell, Royal Navy official photographer, IWM A 6333. Crown copyright expired, public domain. Legion's pennant G74 cropped out so it cannot lead to the answer.
photoCredit: HMS Ark Royal listing after the torpedo hit, with HMS Legion alongside taking off survivors, 13 November 1941. Imperial War Museum A 6333, public domain.
